# Chapter Thirteen: Check and Mate (Part II)

Check and Mate

What do you mean you lost them” Rogan shot at the small group of frightened soldiers, six he told himself of the twenty-five soldiers sent to retrieve Marcus and the two female mages only six had returned he thought bitterly? They had relayed the story, losing the first five people to the older mages power and then the assault from Silvan’s and humans as they swooped in to save his prize. He was so close he thought he had almost secured the Empress’s prize, had almost become the most favored and now he would have to report his failure, because these soldiers could not do a simple job he thought anger brimming over as he walked back to the window. Gathering power, he pushed it at the soldiers, and they lifted off the ground, he listened to the gagging as he willed the air around their head gone and stood at the window until every last one had stopped moving for a good two minutes. Releasing them the bodies simply dropped to the floor like ragdolls “Clean that up” he said casually to the two servants who stood cowering in the corner.

Leaving the room, he walked out into the main foyer of the large keep. The wardens had been given an incredible fortress he thought marveling at the four-story foyer, studying the stones and rafters, everyone walking into this keep would feel insignificant and reveled in the thought of that. Maybe he would ask for this place once he secured Marcus from the Silvans he thought. After all they had been ordered to take the city, they were not to destroy the trees though, something in them held a prize the Empress needed, but she did not require the population or the buildings, just the trees he thought smiling. “Well I don’t see this person, this prize maybe you hid him” came the mocking voice from behind and Rogan winced as Lord Seer Kol Bures strolled up behind him, Bures had been charged with gathering the strike force that would take the Barrens, they would be responsible for subjugating the Silvans and prepare the north for invasion, according to the Empress there were cities and species that had not been seen in generations, the Empress wanted something the Silvan’s possed before she invaded Vicor’s neighbors. Rogan did not know what the Empress required from these places, only that she did that was enough for him. “hmmm, maybe he is in your pocket, is that it Rogan” Bures teased he too was vying for the Empress’s favor as were all the chosen, and the bastard was gloating in Rogan’s failure.

“It was only a small setback Bures, we have him right where we want him” Rogan said casually shooting the other seer a reassuring grin. Bures studied his fellow Lord his eyes narrowing “Right where I want him you mean, this is my mission, which means if I capture him, he is my bounty” Bures stated shrugging as he turned to walk down the spiral stairs of the keep. “No Bures, he is still my mission, which means I will be joining your assault, besides with your lack of military experience I would expect you to want all the help you could get my friend” Rogan said and watch Bures paused, Rogan smiled knowing the barb had hit home. “Very well Rogan, lets hope you don’t loose him again or the Empress might decide to give the mission to someone, more capable” he finished and then continued down the stairs. Rogan had to summon all his will not to fling him down the stairs and drop large rocks on him until he died. Bures was a chosen, the Empress would look down on such behavior he thought, calming himself.

The Empress had sent her orders, they were to wait until the soldiers were reinforced, three Seers and six screamers would assault the northern dominance and take the Silvan city, once secure she would send an envoy to collect that which she sought. They however would use the city as a staging point into the north. There were territories north that no man had traveled to in generations, riches and resources to be seized he thought smiling as he imagined the gold lioness spreading far into the north expanding the little country of Vicor into a true world power. Rogan followed his fellow Seer descending the large stone stairs as he looked up appreciating yet again the imposing room gave users that feeling of insignificance and intimidation.

The more he toured the large keep the more he resolved himself to asking the Empress for it. If he could produce Marcus, alive to her he was positive she would grant whatever wish, within reason he could think of. The thought made him smile as he stepped onto the stone floor and turned to head deeper into the keep. Loric found him as he walked “My Lord, the latest reports from your territory” he said handing the stack of parchment over to him. Rogan rolled his eyes and shot a pointed look at his assistant “sum it up for me Loric, you know I don’t have time to go over this now, I have an assault to plan” he finished and Loric smiled, he knew very well his Lord never liked the paperwork end of leading that was one of the reason’s he had him. Loric took a break organizing his thoughts. “We have two issues, one was a revolt led in the small village of Jaster, however it was put down quickly, the loss was twenty workers, but the soldier leading the work detail tells me they will be able to make up the shortfall with a few extra hours overall. Our output is thirty percent less than expected” he said and then waited he knew very well his Lord would not be pleased at that.

Rogan stopped and turned towards Loric “thirty percent Loric, that is not acceptable” he whispered, and his assistant averted his eyes nodding. “I know my lord, I have directed the work detail captains to push the workers harder, we cannot be seen to be lacking in our shipments to the Empress” he finished surmising the exact orders he would have given. A small smiled spread across Rogan’s face “you did well, if the shortfall continues, I will send the screamers to make an example” he finished and Loric winced. Knowing what example, they would give and the mess it would leave.

Rogan continued into the depths of the old keep finally coming to the door he had been looking for, stepping through he found a small group of men, his men as they cleaned up and changed washing off the road dirt and grime of traveling. “Report” Rogan barked as he walked into the living quarters of his recon patrol.

They quickly shot to attention stopping whatever it was they were doing, and the leader stepped forward. “Sir, we completed our survey of the territory line” he began, and Rogan made a continue motion with his hand, he knew the orders they had, he had given them. The soldier nodded curtly and continued “Sir, refugees keep escaping over the border, the Silvan’s seem to be housing them in one of four camps, I have marked them on the map. I know our orders don’t include these but is it the Lords wish to avoid these upon our invasion” the soldier asked, and Rogan thought about it for a moment and then a small malicious smile spread across his face

“No Captain, they have abandoned there Empress, this is treason, we will take the camps and we will execute all those inside as an example to what happens to those who try and flee, we need to show them there is no hope, no safe harbor a mundane’s destiny is to serve those with power.” He finished and the Captain nodded, his thoughts on the subject kept to himself. But Rogan knew that mundanes always felt uncomfortable when it was pointed out they were the inferior species, but what did he care, it was better to live in reality he thought. “What else captain” he pressed and with another curt not the captain continued “We know the Wardens escaped north as well, they have been walking patrols along the border combined with Silan soldiers, we also believe they are laying traps throughout the forest to hamper our incursion my Lord” Rogan nodded he had suspected they would do something like that, but he had a little surprise in store for them and there traps.

After the briefing he left the keep venturing out to the camp where two thousand soldiers prepared for war. Walking for a bit he watched as they sharpened swords and cleaned guns, the lines of cannons were being serviced before moving out as well and he smiled, they had a few other surprises for the Silvan’s he thought chuckling as he imagined their reaction.

Rogan passed the holding pen covered to keep them out of sight of the soldiers inside forty screamers slept, waiting for the orders that would unleash them against the enemy. Passing the cages holding the creatures he finally came to his destination a small tent with smoke billowing out a makeshift chimney as the smiths inside worked frantically building and repairing armor and weapons as the final moments before battle counted down. The old man half his face covered with soot bowed deeply as Rogan entered the tent. “My Lord, you are early” he stated, and The Seer narrowed his eyes “Is that your way of telling me it’s not ready?” he asked the anger and disapproval in his tone evident. The man visibly flinched but shook his head “No My Lord, they are ready” he said and then turned, retrieving a large ornate wooden box. “The set came from the capital two days ago, we spent all last night finishing the customizations, I believe it will be to your liking” he finished and held out the box. Rogan took it, the wooden box was heavier than he expected but he still carried it easily as he turned without speaking and heading back to the keep.

The next day, Rogan awoke early before the sun rose through the trees and opened the box the smith had handed to him. He pulled out metal and leather and began to outfit himself with the armor he had requested built. Ones that would allow him to nullify direct attacks by other Mages. He had fought Marcus in fact he was more then a match for the Empress’s prize, but he also knew that Silvan had their own mages and he had heard the stories, he would not be felled by a mage, not today, not this close to success he thought.

Standing in front of the mirror the leather outfit covered with pieces of bright shining silver plates, each ornately carved with runic designs meant to protect the wearer. He smiled as he admired the look, Rogan was a battle mage, he was a runic mage and now he looked the part. Picking up the short staff, the quintessential mage weapon for its ability allow the mage to throw power more accurately then even the focus rune they each wore. He clipped it to the holder on his belt, with a deep breath he left his quarters and entered the chaos as everyone prepared to march to war.

Entering the main hall, he found his counterpart giving the last orders to the captains prior to the march for the northern dominance. “Lord Seer Bures, I take it everything is in order for our journey” Rogan asked casually as if the two were going on a stroll instead of invading a country. Bures turned and nodded “Lord Seer Rogan, we are well prepared and should be marching out within the hour, I assume you will be ready?” he asked the small mocking smile not going unnoticed to Rogan who ignored the barb and nodded, looking out towards the fields where the tents had been dismantled and a convoy grew by the moment as soldiers mustered and supplies were put into the carts. Rogan stood there admiring the growing line, the Empress’s war machine. Though it had been hard getting even these troops for the missions as aside from those who had been conscripted still training, the remainder of the army was parked on the eastern border waiting for there turn. But the Empress had been specific before she could invade the eastern territories, she required Marcus and items from within the Silvan’s domain however once she had these then the armies would sweep east over the land conquering country after country until the only thing left was Vicor and the Empress.

He understood her goal, he knew she would not rest until she saw mankind under a single rule, a single goal and looking out among the soldiers he could see that vision forming and he smiled, they would take the Silvan city, they would find Marcus and the items the Empress needed from the Silvans, upon returning he would ask for Warden’s keep, her plan would become reality because of his will, his drive and his power.

Two hours later Rogan found himself at the head of the large line of soldiers and supplies Bores to his left as with a shout the line began to march.

War was coming to the North…
